Inflation Forecasting Evidence

This paper proposes a forecasting model for inflation using monthly macroeconomic observations and a transparent estimation method.

The dataset contains monthly observations from 1990 to 2025 and the model is compared with an ARIMA baseline using RMSE and CRPS metrics.

The main limitation is that robustness to real-time data revisions is not fully tested, although replication code is available in a public repository.

The practitioner value is linked to inflation monitoring and central bank forecasting workflows where uncertainty estimates are useful.
